bandReport.notes: Band covers items 61-80, NOT the 66-85 the assignment estimated; pages were trusted over the estimate. Page->booklet mapping: p14=booklet p.29 (items 61-64), p15=p.31 (65-70), p16=p.33 (71-76), p17=p.35 (77-80). PDF pages are consecutive English-only pages carrying odd booklet page numbers, so no items are lost between them. Item 61 begins at the top of p14-c1 whole; item 80 ends with all four options above the [P.T.O. on p17-c2, so neither band edge is cut. All eight column crops are clean at the gutter; no sliced lines, no missing item numbers, no fragments of the neighbouring column. Faint Hindi show-through from the reverse of each leaf is visible in several crops but never overlaps the English text. VERBATIM ODDITIES PRESERVED, transcribed as printed and not corrected: Q70 statement 2 prints 'Common cold is sometime caused' (not 'sometimes'); Q78 statement 1 prints 'N. Gopalaswamy Iyengar Committee' (the historical name is usually rendered N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar); Q63 statement 5 and Q76 use the booklet's own hyphenation ('bio-fuels' is printed solid as 'biofuels', 'light-years' hyphenated). Q75 prints a stray ink speck after the '(c)' label; treated as a scan artefact, not transcribed. SOFT-SUBTOPIC WARNINGS I expect the merge to raise: Q62 uses subtopic 'Global Distribution of Water' (the catalog has no hydrology chapter; filed under Geography > Climatology as the nearest home for the hydrological cycle). All other subject/chapter pairs are copied exactly from catalog.json and every chapter belongs to its own subject. No answers supplied anywhere in this file.
